passages.text: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying, “Stand in the gate of the house of the LORD and proclaim this message: Hear the word of the LORD, all you people of Judah who enter through these gates to worship the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Jeremiah.
The LORD gave Jeremiah a message.
The LORD told Jeremiah what to do.
Jeremiah was a prophet.
The LORD said, “Stand in the gate of the house of the LORD.
Speak this message at the gate.
Say these words to the people.
All the people of Judah come through these gates.
They come to worship the LORD.
Tell them, ‘Hear the word of the LORD.’”
passages.original: הַדָּבָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָיָ֣ה אֶֽל־ יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ מֵאֵ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃ עֲמֹ֗ד בְּשַׁ֙עַר֙ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה וְקָרָ֣אתָ שָּׁ֔ם אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֖ר הַזֶּ֑ה וְאָמַרְתָּ֞ שִׁמְע֣וּ דְבַר־ יְהוָ֗ה כָּל־ יְהוּדָה֙ הַבָּאִים֙ בַּשְּׁעָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה לְהִֽשְׁתַּחֲוֺ֖ת לַיהוָֽה׃ס

passages.text: Thus says the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel: Correct your ways and deeds, and I will let you live in this place.
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts is the God of Israel.
The LORD of Hosts speaks.
He says, “Change your ways.
Change your actions.
Do what is right.
If you do this, I will let you live here.
You may stay in this place.”
passages.original: כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֞ר יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הֵיטִ֥יבוּ דַרְכֵיכֶ֖ם וּמַֽעַלְלֵיכֶ֑ם וַאֲשַׁכְּנָ֣ה אֶתְכֶ֔ם בַּמָּק֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃

passages.text: Do not trust in deceptive words, chanting: ‘This is the temple of the LORD, the temple of the LORD, the temple of the LORD.’
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Jeremiah.
God told Jeremiah to warn the people of Judah.
God told Jeremiah to speak at the gate of the Lord’s house.
God told Jeremiah to tell the people not to trust lies.
Do not believe false words.
Do not say, “This is the temple of the Lord.”
Do not repeat, “The temple of the Lord, the temple of the Lord, the temple of the Lord.”
These words are deceptive.
Trusting in these words will not save you.
passages.original: אַל־ תִּבְטְח֣וּ לָכֶ֔ם אֶל־ דִּבְרֵ֥י הַשֶּׁ֖קֶר לֵאמֹ֑ר הֵיכַ֤ל יְהוָה֙ הֵיכַ֣ל יְהוָ֔ה הֵיכַ֥ל יְהוָ֖ה הֵֽמָּה׃

passages.text: For if you really correct your ways and deeds, if you act justly toward one another, if you no longer oppress the foreigner and the fatherless and the widow, and if you no longer shed innocent blood in this place or follow other gods to your own harm, then I will let you live in this place, in the land that I gave to your fathers forever and ever.
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts is the God of Israel.
He speaks to His people.
He says, "If you truly change your ways and your actions, I will bless you."
You must do what is right between one person and another.
You must not oppress the foreigner.
You must not oppress the fatherless.
You must not oppress the widow.
You must not shed innocent blood in this place.
You must not follow other gods, because that will harm you.
If you do these things, I will let you live in this place.
This is the land I gave to your fathers.
I gave it to them forever.
You may live here forever if you obey.
passages.original: כִּ֤י אִם־ הֵיטֵיב֙ תֵּיטִ֔יבוּ אֶת־ דַּרְכֵיכֶ֖ם וְאֶת־ מַֽעַלְלֵיכֶ֑ם אִם־ עָשׂ֤וֹ תַֽעֲשׂוּ֙ מִשְׁפָּ֔ט בֵּ֥ין אִ֖ישׁ וּבֵ֥ין רֵעֵֽהוּ׃ גֵּ֣ר יָת֤וֹם וְאַלְמָנָה֙ לֹ֣א תַֽעֲשֹׁ֔קוּ וְדָ֣ם נָקִ֔י אַֽל־ תִּשְׁפְּכ֖וּ בַּמָּק֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה וְאַחֲרֵ֨י אֱלֹהִ֧ים אֲחֵרִ֛ים לֹ֥א תֵלְכ֖וּ לְרַ֥ע לָכֶֽם׃ וְשִׁכַּנְתִּ֤י אֶתְכֶם֙ בַּמָּק֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה בָּאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לַאֲבֽוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם לְמִן־ עוֹלָ֖ם וְעַד־ עוֹלָֽם׃

passages.text: But look, you keep trusting in deceptive words to no avail.
passages.sermon:
The people trust in deceptive words.
These words do not help them.
Trusting in lies brings no benefit.
Their trust is useless.
passages.original: הִנֵּ֤ה אַתֶּם֙ בֹּטְחִ֣ים לָכֶ֔ם עַל־ דִּבְרֵ֖י הַשָּׁ֑קֶר לְבִלְתִּ֖י הוֹעִֽיל׃

passages.text: Will you steal and murder, commit adultery and perjury, burn incense to Baal, and follow other gods that you have not known, and then come and stand before Me in this house, which bears My Name, and say, ‘We are delivered, so we can continue with all these abominations’?
passages.sermon:
The Lord speaks to the people of Judah.
You steal.
You murder.
You commit adultery.
You swear falsely.
You burn incense to Baal.
You follow other gods.
You do not know these other gods.
Then you come and stand before Me.
You stand in this house.
This house bears My Name.
You say, “We are delivered.”
You say this so you can keep doing all these evil things.
passages.original: הֲגָנֹ֤ב׀ רָצֹ֙חַ֙ וְֽנָאֹ֔ף וְהִשָּׁבֵ֥עַ לַשֶּׁ֖קֶר וְקַטֵּ֣ר לַבָּ֑עַל וְהָלֹ֗ךְ אַחֲרֵ֛י אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֲחֵרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־ יְדַעְתֶּֽם׃ וּבָאתֶ֞ם וַעֲמַדְתֶּ֣ם לְפָנַ֗י בַּבַּ֤יִת הַזֶּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִקְרָא־ שְׁמִ֣י עָלָ֔יו וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֖ם נִצַּ֑לְנוּ לְמַ֣עַן עֲשׂ֔וֹת אֵ֥ת כָּל־ הַתּוֹעֵב֖וֹת הָאֵֽלֶּה׃

passages.text: Has this house, which bears My Name, become a den of robbers in your sight? Yes, I too have seen it, declares the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks.
The LORD’s Name is on this house.
You see this house.
You think this house has become a den of robbers.
I, the LORD, have seen it too.
passages.original: הַמְעָרַ֣ת פָּרִצִ֗ים הָיָ֨ה הַבַּ֧יִת הַזֶּ֛ה אֲשֶׁר־ נִקְרָֽא־ שְׁמִ֥י עָלָ֖יו בְּעֵינֵיכֶ֑ם גַּ֧ם אָנֹכִ֛י הִנֵּ֥ה רָאִ֖יתִי נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃ס

passages.text: But go now to the place in Shiloh where I first made a dwelling for My Name, and see what I did to it because of the wickedness of My people Israel.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the people of Israel.
God tells them to go to Shiloh.
Shiloh is the place where God first made His Name dwell.
God says, "Go and look at Shiloh."
God tells them to see what He did to Shiloh.
God acted because of the wickedness of His people Israel.
God punished Shiloh because the people did evil.
passages.original: כִּ֣י לְכוּ־ נָ֗א אֶל־ מְקוֹמִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּשִׁיל֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֨ר שִׁכַּ֧נְתִּֽי שְׁמִ֛י שָׁ֖ם בָּרִֽאשׁוֹנָ֑ה וּרְאוּ֙ אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁר־ עָשִׂ֣יתִי ל֔וֹ מִפְּנֵ֕י רָעַ֖ת עַמִּ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: And now, because you have done all these things, declares the LORD, and because I have spoken to you again and again but you would not listen, and I have called to you but you would not answer, therefore what I did to Shiloh I will now do to the house that bears My Name, the house in which you trust, the place that I gave to you and your fathers.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks to His people.
You have done all these things.
I, the LORD, have spoken to you again and again.
You did not listen to Me.
I called to you.
You did not answer Me.
I will act against the house that bears My Name.
You trust in this house.
I gave this house and this place to you and to your fathers.
I will do to this house what I did to Shiloh.
passages.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה יַ֧עַן עֲשׂוֹתְכֶ֛ם אֶת־ כָּל־ הַמַּֽעֲשִׂ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֑ה וָאֲדַבֵּ֨ר אֲלֵיכֶ֜ם הַשְׁכֵּ֤ם וְדַבֵּר֙ וְלֹ֣א שְׁמַעְתֶּ֔ם וָאֶקְרָ֥א אֶתְכֶ֖ם וְלֹ֥א עֲנִיתֶֽם׃ וְעָשִׂ֜יתִי לַבַּ֣יִת׀ אֲשֶׁ֧ר נִֽקְרָא־ שְׁמִ֣י עָלָ֗יו אֲשֶׁ֤ר אַתֶּם֙ בֹּטְחִ֣ים בּ֔וֹ וְלַ֨מָּק֔וֹם אֲשֶׁר־ נָתַ֥תִּי לָכֶ֖ם וְלַאֲבֽוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשִׂ֖יתִי לְשִׁלֽוֹ׃

passages.text: And I will cast you out of My presence, just as I have cast out all your brothers, all the descendants of Ephraim.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the people of Judah.
God says, “I will cast you out of My presence.
I did this before to your brothers.
I cast out all the descendants of Ephraim.
I will do the same to you.”
passages.original: וְהִשְׁלַכְתִּ֥י אֶתְכֶ֖ם מֵעַ֣ל פָּנָ֑י כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר הִשְׁלַ֙כְתִּי֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ אֲחֵיכֶ֔ם אֵ֖ת כָּל־ זֶ֥רַע אֶפְרָֽיִם׃ס

passages.text: As for you, do not pray for these people, do not offer a plea or petition on their behalf, and do not beg Me, for I will not listen to you.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to Jeremiah.
God commands Jeremiah.
Do not pray for these people.
Do not offer a plea for them.
Do not bring a petition for them.
Do not beg Me for them.
I will not listen to you.
passages.original: וְאַתָּ֞ה אַל־ תִּתְפַּלֵּ֣ל׀ בְּעַד־ הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֗ה וְאַל־ תִּשָּׂ֧א בַעֲדָ֛ם רִנָּ֥ה וּתְפִלָּ֖ה וְאַל־ תִּפְגַּע־ בִּ֑י כִּי־ אֵינֶ֥נִּי שֹׁמֵ֖עַ אֹתָֽךְ׃

passages.text: Do you not see what they are doing in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?
passages.sermon:
God speaks to Jeremiah.
God asks a question.
God says, “Do you see what these people are doing?”
They act in the cities of Judah.
They act in the streets of Jerusalem.
passages.original: הַֽאֵינְךָ֣ רֹאֶ֔ה מָ֛ה הֵ֥מָּה עֹשִׂ֖ים בְּעָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה וּבְחֻצ֖וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

passages.text: The sons gather wood, the fathers light the fire, and the women knead the dough to make cakes for the Queen of Heaven; they pour out drink offerings to other gods to provoke Me to anger.
passages.sermon:
The people of Judah and Jerusalem commit idolatry.
The sons gather wood.
The fathers light the fire.
The women knead the dough.
They make cakes for the Queen of Heaven.
They pour out drink offerings to other gods.
They do these things to provoke Me to anger.
passages.original: הַבָּנִ֞ים מְלַקְּטִ֣ים עֵצִ֗ים וְהָֽאָבוֹת֙ מְבַעֲרִ֣ים אֶת־ הָאֵ֔שׁ וְהַנָּשִׁ֖ים לָשׁ֣וֹת בָּצֵ֑ק לַעֲשׂ֨וֹת כַּוָּנִ֜ים לִמְלֶ֣כֶת הַשָּׁמַ֗יִם וְהַסֵּ֤ךְ נְסָכִים֙ לֵאלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים לְמַ֖עַן הַכְעִסֵֽנִי׃

passages.text: But am I the One they are provoking? declares the LORD. Is it not themselves they spite, to their own shame?
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks.
The LORD asks a question.
The people provoke the LORD.
The LORD says, “Are they really provoking Me?”
The LORD says, “They are harming themselves.”
They bring shame on their own faces.
passages.original: הַאֹתִ֛י הֵ֥ם מַכְעִסִ֖ים נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֑ה הֲל֣וֹא אֹתָ֔ם לְמַ֖עַן בֹּ֥שֶׁת פְּנֵיהֶֽם׃ס

passages.text: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Behold, My anger and My fury will be poured out on this place, on man and beast, on the trees of the field and the produce of the land, and it will burn and not be extinguished.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
He is the God of Israel.
He says, “Look, I will pour out My anger and My fury on this place.
My anger will come upon people.
My anger will come upon animals.
My anger will come upon the trees in the field.
My anger will come upon the crops of the land.
My anger will burn like fire.
No one will put out this fire.”
passages.original: לָכֵ֞ן כֹּה־ אָמַ֣ר׀ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהֹוִ֗ה הִנֵּ֨ה אַפִּ֤י וַֽחֲמָתִי֙ נִתֶּ֙כֶת֙ אֶל־ הַמָּק֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה עַל־ הָֽאָדָם֙ וְעַל־ הַבְּהֵמָ֔ה וְעַל־ עֵ֥ץ הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה וְעַל־ פְּרִ֣י הָֽאֲדָמָ֑ה וּבָעֲרָ֖ה וְלֹ֥א תִכְבֶּֽה׃ס

passages.text: This is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: Add your burnt offerings to your other sacrifices and eat the meat yourselves!
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts is the God of Israel.
He speaks to the people.
He says, “Add your burnt offerings to your other sacrifices.
Eat the meat yourselves.”
passages.original: כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל עֹלוֹתֵיכֶ֛ם סְפ֥וּ עַל־ זִבְחֵיכֶ֖ם וְאִכְל֥וּ בָשָֽׂר׃

passages.text: For when I brought your fathers out of the land of Egypt, I did not merely command them about burnt offerings and sacrifices, but this is what I commanded them: Obey Me, and I will be your God, and you will be My people. You must walk in all the ways I have commanded you, so that it may go well with you.
passages.sermon:
God brought the ancestors of Israel out of Egypt.
God did not only command them about burnt offerings and sacrifices.
God gave them this command.
God said, "Obey My voice."
God said, "I will be your God."
God said, "You will be My people."
God said, "Walk in all the ways I command you."
God said, "Then it will go well with you."
passages.original: כִּ֠י לֹֽא־ דִבַּ֤רְתִּי אֶת־ אֲבֽוֹתֵיכֶם֙ וְלֹ֣א צִוִּיתִ֔ים בְּי֛וֹם הוֹצִיא אוֹתָ֖ם מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם עַל־ דִּבְרֵ֥י עוֹלָ֖ה וָזָֽבַח׃ כִּ֣י אִֽם־ אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֣ר הַ֠זֶּה צִוִּ֨יתִי אוֹתָ֤ם לֵאמֹר֙ שִׁמְע֣וּ בְקוֹלִ֔י וְהָיִ֤יתִי לָכֶם֙ לֵֽאלֹהִ֔ים וְאַתֶּ֖ם תִּֽהְיוּ־ לִ֣י לְעָ֑ם וַהֲלַכְתֶּ֗ם בְּכָל־ הַדֶּ֙רֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֲצַוֶּ֣ה אֶתְכֶ֔ם לְמַ֖עַן יִיטַ֥ב לָכֶֽם׃

passages.text: Yet they did not listen or incline their ear, but they followed the stubborn inclinations of their own evil hearts. They went backward and not forward.
passages.sermon:
The people of Israel did not listen to God.
They did not pay attention to His words.
They followed their own advice.
Their hearts were stubborn and evil.
They went backward.
They did not move forward.
passages.original: וְלֹ֤א שָֽׁמְעוּ֙ וְלֹֽא־ הִטּ֣וּ אֶת־ אָזְנָ֔ם וַיֵּֽלְכוּ֙ בְּמֹ֣עֵצ֔וֹת בִּשְׁרִר֖וּת לִבָּ֣ם הָרָ֑ע וַיִּהְי֥וּ לְאָח֖וֹר וְלֹ֥א לְפָנִֽים׃

passages.text: From the day your fathers came out of the land of Egypt until this day, I have sent you all My servants the prophets again and again.
passages.sermon:
God brought the ancestors of Israel out of Egypt.
From that day until now, God acted.
God sent His servants to the people.
These servants were the prophets.
God sent the prophets again and again.
God sent them to speak to the people.
passages.original: לְמִן־ הַיּ֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָצְא֤וּ אֲבֽוֹתֵיכֶם֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם עַ֖ד הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה וָאֶשְׁלַ֤ח אֲלֵיכֶם֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ עֲבָדַ֣י הַנְּבִיאִ֔ים י֖וֹם הַשְׁכֵּ֥ם וְשָׁלֹֽחַ׃

passages.text: Yet they would not listen to Me or incline their ear, but they stiffened their necks and did more evil than their fathers.
passages.sermon:
The people did not listen to Me.
They did not turn their ear toward Me.
They made their necks stiff.
They did more evil than their fathers.
passages.original: וְל֤וֹא שָׁמְעוּ֙ אֵלַ֔י וְלֹ֥א הִטּ֖וּ אֶת־ אָזְנָ֑ם וַיַּקְשׁוּ֙ אֶת־ עָרְפָּ֔ם הֵרֵ֖עוּ מֵאֲבוֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: When you tell them all these things, they will not listen to you. When you call to them, they will not answer.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Jeremiah the prophet.
God told Jeremiah to speak to the people of Judah.
God told Jeremiah to tell them all these things.
The people of Judah will not listen to Jeremiah.
Jeremiah will call to the people of Judah.
The people of Judah will not answer Jeremiah.
passages.original: וְדִבַּרְתָּ֤ אֲלֵיהֶם֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה וְלֹ֥א יִשְׁמְע֖וּ אֵלֶ֑יךָ וְקָרָ֥אתָ אֲלֵיהֶ֖ם וְלֹ֥א יַעֲנֽוּכָה׃

passages.text: Therefore you must say to them, ‘This is the nation that would not listen to the voice of the LORD their God and would not receive correction. Truth has perished; it has disappeared from their lips.
passages.sermon:
This nation does not listen to the LORD their God.
This nation refuses to accept correction.
Truth has vanished from them.
Truth no longer comes from their mouths.
passages.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵיהֶ֗ם זֶ֤ה הַגּוֹי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֽוֹא־ שָׁמְע֗וּ בְּקוֹל֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֔יו וְלֹ֥א לָקְח֖וּ מוּסָ֑ר אָֽבְדָה֙ הָֽאֱמוּנָ֔ה וְנִכְרְתָ֖ה מִפִּיהֶֽם׃ס

passages.text: Cut off your hair and throw it away. Raise up a lamentation on the barren heights, for the LORD has rejected and forsaken the generation of His wrath.’
passages.sermon:
The LORD has rejected His people.
The LORD has turned away from the generation that made Him angry.
Cut off your hair.
Throw your hair away.
Go up to the barren heights.
Cry out in sorrow there.
Mourn for the people God has rejected.
passages.original: גָּזִּ֤י נִזְרֵךְ֙ וְֽהַשְׁלִ֔יכִי וּשְׂאִ֥י עַל־ שְׁפָיִ֖ם קִינָ֑ה כִּ֚י מָאַ֣ס יְהוָ֔ה וַיִּטֹּ֖שׁ אֶת־ דּ֥וֹר עֶבְרָתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: For the people of Judah have done evil in My sight, declares the LORD. They have set up their abominations in the house that bears My Name, and so have defiled it.
passages.sermon:
The people of Judah have done evil.
The LORD sees their actions.
The LORD declares this truth.
The people of Judah placed their abominations in the house of the LORD.
This house carries the LORD’s Name.
The people of Judah defiled the LORD’s house.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ עָשׂ֨וּ בְנֵי־ יְהוּדָ֥ה הָרַ֛ע בְּעֵינַ֖י נְאֻום־ יְהוָ֑ה שָׂ֣מוּ שִׁקּֽוּצֵיהֶ֗ם בַּבַּ֛יִת אֲשֶׁר־ נִקְרָא־ שְׁמִ֥י עָלָ֖יו לְטַמְּאֽוֹ׃

passages.text: They have built the high places of Topheth in the Valley of Hinnom so they could burn their sons and daughters in the fire—something I never commanded, nor did it even enter My mind.
passages.sermon:
The people of Judah built high places at Topheth.
Topheth is in the Valley of Hinnom.
They built these places to burn their sons in the fire.
They also burned their daughters in the fire.
I am the LORD.
I never commanded them to do this.
This idea never entered My mind.
passages.original: וּבָנ֞וּ בָּמ֣וֹת הַתֹּ֗פֶת אֲשֶׁר֙ בְּגֵ֣יא בֶן־ הִנֹּ֔ם לִשְׂרֹ֛ף אֶת־ בְּנֵיהֶ֥ם וְאֶת־ בְּנֹתֵיהֶ֖ם בָּאֵ֑שׁ אֲשֶׁר֙ לֹ֣א צִוִּ֔יתִי וְלֹ֥א עָלְתָ֖ה עַל־ לִבִּֽי׃ס

passages.text: So behold, the days are coming, declares the LORD, when this place will no longer be called Topheth and the Valley of Hinnom, but the Valley of Slaughter. For they will bury the dead in Topheth until there is no more room.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks to the people of Judah.
He says, “Days are coming.
This is what the LORD declares.
People will not call this place Topheth anymore.
They will not call it the Valley of Hinnom anymore.
They will call it the Valley of Slaughter.
People will bury the dead in Topheth.
There will be no more room left to bury anyone.
passages.original: לָכֵ֞ן הִנֵּֽה־ יָמִ֤ים בָּאִים֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה וְלֹא־ יֵאָמֵ֨ר ע֤וֹד הַתֹּ֙פֶת֙ וְגֵ֣יא בֶן־ הִנֹּ֔ם כִּ֖י אִם־ גֵּ֣יא הַהֲרֵגָ֑ה וְקָבְר֥וּ בְתֹ֖פֶת מֵאֵ֥ין מָקֽוֹם׃

passages.text: The corpses of this people will become food for the birds of the air and the beasts of the earth, and there will be no one to scare them away.
passages.sermon:
God speaks about the people of Judah and Jerusalem.
These people have sinned greatly.
Their dead bodies will lie unburied.
Birds of the sky will eat their corpses.
Wild animals of the earth will also eat them.
No one will drive the birds or animals away.
passages.original: וְֽהָ֨יְתָ֜ה נִבְלַ֨ת הָעָ֤ם הַזֶּה֙ לְמַֽאֲכָ֔ל לְע֥וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם וּלְבֶהֱמַ֣ת הָאָ֑רֶץ וְאֵ֖ין מַחֲרִֽיד׃

passages.text: I will remove from the cities of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem the sounds of joy and gladness and the voices of the bride and bridegroom, for the land will become a wasteland.”
passages.sermon:
The Lord speaks to the people of Judah and Jerusalem.
He says He will act.
He will remove the sounds of joy from the cities of Judah.
He will take away the sounds of gladness from the streets of Jerusalem.
No one will hear the voice of the bridegroom.
No one will hear the voice of the bride.
The land will become a wasteland.
passages.original: וְהִשְׁבַּתִּ֣י׀ מֵעָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֗ה וּמֵֽחֻצוֹת֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם ק֤וֹל שָׂשׂוֹן֙ וְק֣וֹל שִׂמְחָ֔ה ק֥וֹל חָתָ֖ן וְק֣וֹל כַּלָּ֑ה כִּ֥י לְחָרְבָּ֖ה תִּהְיֶ֥ה הָאָֽרֶץ׃
